# awscc_apiportal_product_managed_api_association (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::APIPortal::ProductManagedApiAssociation. Associates a set of AWS::APIPortal::ManagedApi resources with an AWS::APIPortal::Product. The resource owns all of the product's Managed API associations.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `managed_api_ids` (Set of String) The identifiers of the Managed APIs to associate with the product.
- `product_id` (String) The identifier of the product. The product must use CUSTOM API selection.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_apiportal_product_managed_api_association.example
  identity = {
    product_id = "product_id"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `product_id` (String) The identifier of the product

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_apiportal_product_managed_api_association.example
  id = "product_id"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_apiportal_product_managed_api_association.example "product_id"
```
